In reply to fraGolinaKR: Hey! This should be improved in v0.0.13. There was a bug where the chat formatter wasn't being applied when a player had message colors set but no nickname.
 
Also, if you're using Essentials Core alongside this plugin, make sure to disable Essentials Core's chat formatting (set chat.enabled = false in Essentials config) — both plugins try to set the chat formatter and they can override each other. NickNameChanger already handles LuckPerms prefixes/suffixes natively, so you won't lose any formatting.
 
Please update and let me know if it helps!

Seems to be very broken, and I wish it wasn't cause it does exactly what I want.
 
I just need a plugin that allows me to change usernames in the map list when you press M. I just want to give donators / staff a small prefix to make it a little bit more organized. This mod does this, but it also changes the name in game, and above your head. There is an option to turn these off, but they don't seem to work. I can only apply changes to all 3, and not have just the map list enabled.
 
This mod also seems to break my luckperms group colors. When this plugin is in non of my groups have color in their prefix in chat, it's just white ranks. As soon as I take the plugin out I get my color back.
 
I wish I could just simply disable everything this plugin does, other then changes names in map list.

replies.text: 0.0.18 fixes the player-command check on server 0.6.8 and makes /nnc the main command. Use it when EliteEssentials owns /nick. NNC now syncs nicknames to EliteEssentials' {player}. Basic NNC features need no other mod. For message colors in EE chat, install a compatible version of HelpChat PlaceholderAPI and put %nnc_msgcolor_legacy% immediately before {message} in EE's chat formats. This token uses the first color of a message gradient. I don't read CurseForge comments, so please report future bugs on GitHub Issues: https://github.com/UberMorgott/Hytale-Mod-NickNameChanger/issues
